method: Static inspection of selected stage production patches for all ten cases, combined endpoints and representative test changes; no historical runtime tests rerun. All test patch inventories screened; private-history and image test bodies selectively inspected. Counts are unweighted Git numstat, not effort. Stage sums include repeated edits; endpoint changes include selected path union only.

patch_hash_recipe.stage_series: UTF-8 of newline-joined git show --format=fuller --find-renames --unified=3 COMMIT -- production_and_test_patch_paths, in selected_commits order; each command retains its trailing newline.
